mapper.select: select id, assignment_id, student_no, student_name_snapshot, submit_content, attachment_name, attachment_url, attachment_type, submit_time, status, score, teacher_comment, review_teacher_id, review_time, version, create_time, update_time from homework_submission where assignment_id = #{assignmentId} and student_no = #{studentNo}

select id, assignment_id, student_no, student_name_snapshot, submit_content, attachment_name, attachment_url, attachment_type, submit_time, status, score, teacher_comment, review_teacher_id, review_time, version, create_time, update_time from homework_submission where id = #{id}

select sub.id as submissionId, stu.id as studentId, stu.student_code as studentCode, stu.student_name as studentName, stu.phone as phone, stu.graduation_session as graduationSession, stu.school as school, sub.status as status, sub.submit_content as submitContent, sub.attachment_name as attachmentName, sub.attachment_url as attachmentUrl, sub.attachment_url as attachmentDownloadUrl, sub.attachment_type as attachmentType, sub.submit_time as submitTime, sub.score, sub.teacher_comment as teacherComment, sub.review_teacher_id as reviewTeacherId, coalesce(rev_u.real_name, rev_u.nickname, rev_u.username) as reviewTeacherName, sub.review_time as reviewTime, sub.version as version from edu_student stu inner join homework_assignment a on a.class_id = stu.class_id and a.id = #{assignmentId} and a.deleted = 0 left join homework_submission sub on sub.assignment_id = a.id and sub.student_no = stu.student_code left join sys_user rev_u on rev_u.id = sub.review_teacher_id
1 = 1
and stu.student_code like concat('%', #{studentCode}, '%')
and stu.student_name like concat('%', #{studentName}, '%')
and sub.id is null
and sub.status = #{status}
order by case when sub.submit_time is null then 1 else 0 end, sub.submit_time desc, stu.id asc
mapper.insert: insert into homework_submission ( assignment_id, student_no, student_name_snapshot, submit_content, attachment_name, attachment_url, attachment_type, submit_time, status, score, teacher_comment, review_teacher_id, review_time, version, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{assignmentId}, #{studentNo}, #{studentNameSnapshot}, #{submitContent}, #{attachmentName}, #{attachmentUrl}, #{attachmentType}, #{submitTime}, #{status}, #{score}, #{teacherComment}, #{reviewTeacherId}, #{reviewTime}, #{version}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.update: update homework_submission set student_name_snapshot = #{studentNameSnapshot}, submit_content = #{submitContent}, attachment_name = #{attachmentName}, attachment_url = #{attachmentUrl}, attachment_type = #{attachmentType}, submit_time = #{submitTime}, status = #{status}, score = #{score}, teacher_comment = #{teacherComment}, review_teacher_id = #{reviewTeacherId}, review_time = #{reviewTime}, version = #{version}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id}
